statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-58010: an off-by-one in the alignment-padding bounds check of gvs_tuple_is_normal() in glib/gvariant-serialiser.c (> instead of >=) lets the GVariant deserialiser read one byte out of bounds (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/work_items/3915, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/commit/8338414f6560216efe67d3cbf549e32f8630252a). Debian fixed it for trixie in glib2.0 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-58010). The DHI Debian 13 repository publishes six glib2.0 builds for amd64 and arm64: three rebuilds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 and three rebuilds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5. The changelog shipped in libglib2.0-0t64 of each 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 rebuild includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that lists CVE-2026-58010 and its patch; the 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 rebuilds predate it and do not list it. The range ends at the first rebuild of 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the lowest published build that carries the fix.
